text:
ivy: Postmortem follow-up: let's turn yesterday's learnings into a tight, testable set of mitigations for rollouts. Key asks: 1) infra hard-cap + cohort-aware sampling, 2) auto-rollback with cost/quality signals, 3) sim artifacts stored for triage, 4) single place to track owners/timelines.
jonas: Agree. I'll take infra hard-cap + cohort sampling. Plan: router enforces `hard_cap_percent` and supports `cohort_selector` so we can limit by user cohort (beta users, internal only).
mei: I'll own the auto-rollback rules and the ``quality_cost`` signal. Idea: combine p95/p99 regressions AND per-token cost delta to avoid rolling back for short bursts of expensive but correct outputs.
paul: I can build quick sim harness and an artifacts bucket: each sim run writes `sim/<date>/<rollout-id>/summary.csv` + logs. We'll wire the run artifact into the PM/postmortem ticket automatically.
sre-bot: system: Task created TASK-8100 (rollout hard-cap + cohort sampling) assigned to jonas.
ivy: Good. Some specifics: default hard_cap should be 1% globally but cohorts can be 5% for internal tiers only. Console should surface the effective cap (min of console slider and infra hard_cap).
jonas: Implementation note: ingress will reject >hard_cap with 429 and emit `X-Rollout-Audit: <rollout-id>` header. We'll also tag events with `cohort` and `owner`. Example config snippet: \n```\nrollout_limits:\n  hard_cap_percent: 1\n  cohort_overrides:\n    internal: 5\n```
paul: Sim command sketch: \n```\npython tools/sim_rollout.py --rollout-id r-2026-04-20 --sweep sample_rate,latency,error --cohorts internal,canary,public --out sim/r-2026-04-20/summary.csv\n```
mei: Auto-rollback pseudo-rule suggestion: require two signals within a 90s window: 
- error_rate_60s > baseline_error * 1.5
- p95_60s > baseline_p95 * 1.25
Additionally, if per_token_cost increases > 20% and quality_drop < 5% we mark as "cost-regression" and surface for manual review (no auto-rollback).
ivy: I like the cost guardrail. Also add a safety fence: if cumulative impacted_users in 5m > 1000 then immediate quarantine regardless of thresholds. That prevents small samples from scaling unexpectedly.
jonas: We'll add `quarantine_timer` default 5m and `impact_budget` parameter. If triggered, rollout goes into quarantined state and widens only after manual approval or exponential reopen backoff.
sre-bot: system: New dry-run scheduled: staging 2026-04-22 09:00 UTC. Please RSVP.
paul: Sim output will include `triggered_rules` column so we can validate which combos cause auto-rollback and which hit impact_budget. I'll add deterministic seeding for CI.
mei: For alerts, require 2 levels: `page` for auto-rollback and `notify` for cost-regressions. Pages include rollout.id, snapshot link, and a short reason.
ivy: Ops playbook updates: add steps for triage when cost-regression flagged: 1) run eval set against snapshot, 2) compare outputs with stable, 3) decide manual rollback or narrow cohort. Assign to aj and ops-docs.
jonas: Also adding a console indicator for `impact_budget_remaining` and a countdown when quarantined. Product asked for an optional `auto-approve` flag for internal experiments only. That stays off by default.
paul: I'll wire sim artifacts to S3 with metadata tags: rollout.id, flag.name, cohort, seed, triggered_rules. We'll keep a 30-day retention by default.
sre-bot: system: Reminder: oncall rota updated.
mei: Tests: 1) sim triggers rule -> assert page + traffic switch to stable; 2) cost-only regression -> assert notify + no rollback; 3) impact budget breach -> assert quarantine + page. I'll add these to CI.
ivy: Owners & deadlines: jonas (hard-cap + cohort sampling) PR by Thu 04/24; mei (rollback rules + alerts) PR by Mon 04/28; paul (sim harness + artifact pipeline) PR by Tue 04/29; aj/ops-docs (playbook) writeup by Wed 04/30.
paul: I'll also add an index file `sim/index.csv` that summarizes recent sims and links to rollouts for easier postmortem scans.
jonas: One more: ensure region-aware caps (per-region hard_cap) so a global 1% doesn't accidentally target a single overloaded region.
ivy: Good catch. Make per-region caps default to same as global but configurable.
sre-bot: system: Task TASK-8112 created: add region-aware caps, assigned to jonas.
paul: I'll open the initial PR today with the sim harness skeleton and sample outputs. Tagging the PR here when ready.
mei: I'll draft the RFC for the rollback combinatorics and tests. Linking when ready.
ivy: Thanks team. Ping this thread with PR links and blockers. We'll validate in the staging dry-run and review progress in next eng-platform sync. :white_check_mark:
